frame.derivation: The research configuration enables the regime with the default single ADX window (period 14, no windows). The Go scheduler fetches regimeRequiredOhlcvLimit(regime) = max(regimeOhlcvBaseLimit 200, 2*14+1 + regimeOhlcvMargin 10) = 200 candles per check (scheduler/regime_multi_window.go, scheduler/hl_batch.go). build-arms re-derives the length from the Go source constants and refuses a mismatch.
frame.decision: closed bar: the research configuration sets closed_bar_decisions true, so the check evaluates the last 200 closed candles; the decision at the close of bar N fills at the open of bar N+1 in the backtester
frame.alignment: positional: the frame for bar N is the 200 source rows ending at bar N, as the venue returns them (a missing candle shortens the time span and is not filled)
frame.warmup_rule: proxy legs load 400 consecutive bars before the window start (eval_windows check_warmup_prehistory); manifest legs use the manifest warm-up of 400 bars; both exceed the 199 bars a full frame needs
frame.decomposition: Per decision bar the driver calls chart_pattern_core on the bounded frame once with htf_gate_factor 0 (the pattern signal before the gate) and calls _htf_gate_trend on the same frame for each factor. The gated signal is the veto rule of chart_pattern_core applied to those two values. replay-check compares this with direct chart_pattern_core calls and with the real signal-check path on frozen inputs, and lock refuses a mismatch.

perps.group_rule: Group membership is fixed here. A member enters a window only when coverage includes it for that window (complete warm-up prefix, priced funding for every scored hour, candles present); the same exclusion applies to both arms of a pair. Each interval is reported separately.

selection_rule.text: Per perps contract and proxy group, on is only: factor 4 is mandatory and is never replaced. An additional factor F in {2, 3, 5, 6} is shortlisted only if its mean net return and mean drawdown-adjusted return across the included datasets both exceed factor 0, it opens at least 30 positions, and an adjacent tested factor (the neighbour of F in 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) also exceeds factor 0 on both measures. At most one additional factor is selected per contract and group: the shortlisted factor with the highest mean drawdown-adjusted return, ties to the lower factor. select writes selection.json once, before any judged window runs, and refuses to replace it.

statistics.unit: daily mark-to-market equity of each leg (last equity per UTC day from the engine equity curve), daily return per dataset, then the equal-weight mean across the group members present that day
statistics.paired: difference of the gated and baseline group daily returns on the same days
statistics.blocks: seven-day calendar blocks counted from each interval start; a block holds the days of one interval only; the same calendar blocks serve every dataset of a group
statistics.method: block bootstrap of the mean daily paired difference: resample whole blocks with replacement to the observed block count; one-sided p = (1 + count of resampled means <= 0) / (1 + resamples)
statistics.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha 0.05 over the predeclared family: 5 perps contracts x 2 proxy groups x 2 factor slots (factor 4 and the selected additional factor) = 20 members; an unselected or unjudged member enters with p = 1, so it cannot reduce the family size
statistics.no_pooling: venue, bridge, proxy, stitched and audit evidence are never pooled as independent observations

verdict_rule.per: perps contract (one direction or the bidirectional book) and proxy group, for factor 4 and for the selected additional factor separately
verdict_rule.opt_in: all of: the BH-corrected paired improvement is significant and its point estimate is positive; the gated arm's net PnL summed over the judged intervals is positive and its mean daily group return is positive; at least 100 opened positions and 30 blocks in the gated arm; usable paired evidence (at least one judged interval) from at least half of the frozen group members; supported venue evidence on the same interval (the venue group of that interval has included members, every venue leg has complete funding and candles, the gated arm's venue net PnL is positive and exceeds the baseline's); no funding, coverage or replay failure in the contract
verdict_rule.inconclusive: any required funding, coverage or replay failure, fewer than 100 positions, fewer than 30 blocks, fewer than half the group members usable, or no venue evidence
verdict_rule.negative: sufficient evidence that fails the opt-in rule
verdict_rule.deployment: No sanitized chart_pattern deployment snapshot is available, so every deployment verdict is inconclusive; research results describe the research configuration only.
verdict_rule.audit: The audit reference uses the historical full-frame path. Its incumbent-relative verdicts are reported per window as a historical reference. Its paired factor 4 versus factor 0 statistic uses the same rule on oos, 2024 and 2025H1t, but a failed full-frame causality check makes the audit conclusion inconclusive; the audit cannot support a perps opt-in.
verdict_rule.suggested_line: A suggested per-strategy parameter line is written only for an opt-in result: {"open_strategy": {"name": "chart_pattern", "params": {"htf_gate_factor": F}}} for the named group, direction and interval.

replay_check.sample_rule: per frozen source file: up to 12 bars with a nonzero pattern signal and 12 bars without, chosen by a seeded generator (seed 2015) from the bars the scored windows read
checks: decomposition: the driver's gated signal equals chart_pattern_core on the bounded frame with that factor
signal_check_path: the driver's signal equals check_hyperliquid.evaluate_signal_slot on the same frame (prebuilt frame, no adapter, no network)
future_invariance: replacing every candle after the decision bar leaves the decision unchanged
htf_visibility: every bucket that reaches the decision is complete by the decision bar's close, and the bucket that holds an unclosed native bar is not visible
next_bar_fill: the real backtester opens each position at the open of the bar after its signal bar
full_frame_causality: on the audit datasets, a full-frame signal at bar N equals chart_pattern_core on the same frame cut at bar N (sampled)

disclosures: Binance US spot candles are a proxy for Hyperliquid perps prices. Proxy results are labeled proxy; Hyperliquid venue evidence is reported separately and covers only the venue tail windows.
No chart_pattern deployment snapshot was available. research_config.json is an explicit research assumption, not a deployment.

The frame length of 200 bars follows from the research regime block. A configuration with longer regime windows fetches more candles and changes the gate's EMA seeding and the pattern detectors' view.
Live forming-candle behavior without closed_bar_decisions is not modeled; the research configuration sets closed_bar_decisions true.
Shared-wallet sizing, leverage tiers other than 1 and margin pooling are not modeled.
The is, oos, 2023, 2024 and 2025H1 windows were examined before for this strategy (see prior_exposure).
